longest_gap.scope: Adjacent retained operating stops ordered by chainage; geography only

gates.reason: Locate and weigh all residual stock, joinery, bogie and service assemblies; obtain complete CG and inertia.
The isolated hollow side-sill fixtures exceed the declared deflection limit. Whole-body load sharing through retained longitudinal members, posts and joints must be demonstrated or redesigned.
Concentrated bogie support changes the body load path. Local/frame fixtures do not establish joined-body stress, buckling, fatigue, crash, modes or bogie qualification.
Qualify wheel profiles, hunting, curves, suspension, ride, flange forces and derailment containment.
No accepted thrust/current/frequency/gap/temperature map for the complete station drive and moving secondary; targets are required forces.
Qualify inverters, section handoff, supply, slip/secondary heat, unwanted normal forces and 120-second repeated duty.
Validate supplier brake/WSP/adhesion/thermal curves, channel failures, parking, receiving-power loss and degraded gradients.
HVAC delivered capacity and COP at 50 C, roof long-term structural temperature and actively cooled service pack remain unqualified.
Reference motion is analytical. Required physical drive/brake maps, wheel dynamics and flexible-body model are not available for a qualified six-car trip.
Existing Rust ATP/interlocking and new wheel interface predicates require candidate-correlated braking, sensing, timing, communications and fault evidence.
Alternative sections are necessary screens. Prestress, fatigue, torsion, lateral/derailment loads, foundations, survey, erection and independent review remain open.
Motorless off-zone restart needs a protected rescue/tow system, emergency access and an acceptable high-viaduct evacuation plan.
No same-service supplier quotes or complete CAPEX/OPEX/renewal comparison; lower installed cost has not been established.
Preserve 266 geographic inputs. Numerical city publication is held pending reference propulsion, braking, route and economic evidence.

native.scope: Actual FreeCAD/STEP export and reopen, limited CalculiX underframe fixtures, GetDP manufactured conductive-slab convergence and Rust ATP/interface regressions. No complete physical train journey.
